prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) was helpful, but placing it after the adoption certificate severely degraded conversion (-22.4%).
Select new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration), targeted hints/clarifications, and specific layout redesigns (Stage, Scroll, Grid, Checklist) were helpful.
Adding multi-step setup flows (System Tray flow, Sound Verification flow) and several screen redesigns (Photo Upload Grid/Card, Split Pick Friend, Waiting Spotlight) hurt conversion (up to -23.3%).
Most standalone copy updates, waiting screen progress/tip carousels, audio cues, notification toggles, and select screens (Troubleshooter, Bio Preview, Controls Overview) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on features that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were often too low or negative (down to -8.0%) for winning changes that ultimately delivered large positive impacts (up to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the Story screen using a split layout to present mascot backstory alongside onboarding options. (why: The choose_path step has a short median time (8s) but a high mean time (514s), indicating some users stall on story introductory context.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] New Path Selection Overview Screen: Add a new path introduction screen before path selection that highlights available pet companion styles. (why: Giving users a clear upfront summary of path options helps smooth initial onboarding drop-offs before path commitment.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] New Pet Personality Intro Screen: Introduce a companion personality preview screen right before picking a friend to give context on pet behaviors. (why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion rate in the funnel at 73.1% and a high median time of 89s.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel Layout Redesign: Rebuild the Pick Friend screen using a carousel layout for browsing available companions smoothly. (why: Adoption step conversion is only 73.1%, making friend selection a primary funnel bottleneck.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Re-login Account Sync Reminder Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original account to preserve pets. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again with different credentials.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background System Readiness Note: Display a system background processing hint on the waiting screen reassuring users while their companion initializes. (why: The waiting step has a huge mean time (2336s) and users report confusion when pets fail to display immediately.)
6: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Pet Activation Prompt: Enable a desktop activation notification prompt on the home intro screen to confirm pet spawning. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on the desktop screen or the app failing to launch.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Screen Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro completion screen using a spotlight layout to highlight final launch controls. (why: The finish step conversion drops to 80.0% with very high mean duration (5815s), showing hesitation at setup completion.)
8: [finish, new_screen] New Desktop Companion Interaction Guide Screen: Add an interaction guide screen before finish explaining how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on the desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails after onboarding expressing confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their new pet.)

scores.note: Choose_path redesigns have consistently delivered positive results (+3.2%).
New screens generally perform well, but extra steps in early pathing show modest gains.
Adoption has the biggest drop-off (73.1%), and new screens on adoption average +4.6%.
Adoption redesigns consistently hurt conversion (-7.8% across 6 tests).
Strong support evidence (8 emails) and hints on sign_in reliably improve step completion (+2.4%).
Waiting screen info changes historically yield near-zero effect (+0.3%).
Notification prompts at finish have shown negative overall relative change (-1.6%).
Finish redesigns show potential (+5.3%), though Spotlight layouts historically hurt.
Supported by 3 emails; finish new screens reliably improve conversion (+3.1%).
